Name: Seasonal Outfits Code Template
Author: AirynS
Description:
Found a neat seasonal mod for a single character but it requires replacing assets in another mod? This mod acts as a code template, allowing you to use single character seasonal outfit mods without needing to replace SCA assets. It does not contain any art assets by itself as it is only a template.

What's the benefits of using this mod instead of just overwriting? With this mod, you can easily switch between mods without needing to redownload the parent mod if you decide that you prefer the original look. It also helps reduce potential issues with incorrect installation, since no files are overwritten.

[b][size=5]Installation:
[/size][size=4]Note: This is not a standard drag-and-drop installation! It does not contain any art files by default![/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download and extract this mod into your Mods folder.
[*]Download and extract the seasonal outfits mod you’d like to convert.
[*]Move any portrait files into the Portraits folder and any character sprite files into the Characters folder.
[*]Configure the mod to select the character that the template is for.
[/list]
If you want to use this template for multiple characters, you will need to download multiple copies of the template.

5. Open the manifest.json in a text editor, find the line
[code]Airyn.SeasonalOutfitsCodeTemplate.One[/code], and change it to
[code]Airyn.SeasonalOutfitsCodeTemplate.Two[/code], etc.

[size=5][b]Configuration:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]“CharacterToReplace”[/b]: Select which character to use with the template.
[*][b]“EnablePortraits”[/b]: Select whether to edit a character’s portraits or only their character sprites.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility:
[/size]
[/b]If using this alongside [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], please make sure to turn off the appropriate character in DSV’s config.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]:

Mod authors are welcome to use this code template as long as I am credited. I'm also happy to work with you in implementing it for your mod if you're unsure where to start.

For additional help in modifying and using the template's code for your own mod, PixelHag, the author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20608]Seasonal Sam with a Mullet[/url], has very kindly written a [url=https://pixelhag.com/2024/04/11/sdv-mods-seasonal-outfits-code-template/]tutorial [/url]﻿that breaks down the template piece by piece! If the tutorial is helpful for you, please make sure to give them an endorsement.
